summary: User asked why Kesehatan Infrastruktur was not under Monitoring. Root cause: layout uses TemplateSidebar (grouped), but item was only added to flat app-sidebar. Fixed by nesting under Monitoring group in template-sidebar and template-mobile-nav alongside Perangkat and Kategori Monitor; also regrouped app-sidebar for consistency.
current_status: Sidebar placement corrected: Kesehatan Infrastruktur is a child of Monitoring. User needs npm run build/dev to see the change.
